junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.title: The Diamond Dogs of Junkville
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.save-yourself-from-the-diamond-dogs: Survive your first Diamond Dogs encounter
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.bring-medical-supplies: Bring medical supplies to the Diamond Dogs
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.solve-pack-unrest: Solve the tension between Fido and Dolly
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.pass-on-message: Forward the Diamond Dogs message to Junkville
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.pass-on-assembly-decision: Forward Junkville's message to the Diamond Dogs
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.convince-fido-to-negotiate: Get Fido on board for talking it out with the Junkville folks.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.convince-randy-to-negotiate: Get Randy on board for talking it out with the Diamond Dogs.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-intro: You found out that Junkville sits right on top of a warren of tunnels, claimed by a pack of Diamond Dogs.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-safe: You walked away from your first run-in with the pack in one piece.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-fido-dead: Fido is dead. Whatever chance there was of talking things out with him died along with him.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-fido-agreed-only: Fido has agreed to hear Junkville out.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-randy-agreed-only: Randy is willing to give negotiation a shot.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-both-agreed: Both Fido and Randy have agreed, separately, to give negotiation a chance.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-trade-accepted: Fido has agreed to let Junkville trade for the gems dug out of the tunnels - assuming everything else falls into place.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-trade-refused: Fido won't budge on the gems. Whatever peace comes out of this, it won't include trade.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-dolly-convinced: Dolly's grumbling about Fido's leadership got talked down before it could turn into anything worse.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-dolly-dead: Dolly is dead. Whatever challenge she posed to Fido's leadership, it died with her.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-dolly-took-over: Dolly didn't wait around to be talked out of anything. She's seized control of the pack from Fido, and she wants nothing to do with ponies.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-message-passed: You carried the Diamond Dogs' terms back up to Junkville.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-assembly-attended: You joined in Junkville's assembly to weigh in on the path the town which to follow regarding the Diamond Dogs.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-decision-passed: You carried Junkville's answer back down to the Diamond Dogs.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-decision-pending: Junkville's assembly reached a decision. It still needs to be carried back down to the Diamond Dogs.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-peace-trade: Junkville and the Diamond Dogs settled on a real peace: an open trade of gems for supplies, and an end - for now - to the fighting.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-peace-boundary: Junkville and the Diamond Dogs settled on an uneasy peace: no trade, no trust, but no more bloodshed either, as long as everyone stays on their own side of the tunnels.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-battle-fled: You pulled out of the underground fighting before it was over.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-battle-won: The fighting is over. Junkville's militia drove the Diamond Dogs back into the dark.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-battle-lost: The fighting is over, and Junkville lost. Too many of its own didn't make it back up out of the tunnels.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-battle-ongoing: Ponies and Diamond Dogs are fighting it out in the tunnels beneath Junkville, right now.
junkvilleNegociateWithDogs.desc-dogs-wiped-out: The Diamond Dogs who once ruled these tunnels are gone - wiped out, with no one left to make peace with, or war on.
